intro: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie at CAVA offers a rich, indulgent finish to your Mediterranean meal. Priced at $2.75 to $2.95 with just 150 calories, this decadent dessert features premium dark cocoa and butter for an authentic fudge experience. Explore this treat on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) alongside other sweet options from the [full CAVA menu](/).
priceCalories: At $2.75 to $2.95, the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie delivers exceptional value for a premium dessert. With only 150 calories per serving, it provides a guilt-conscious indulgence compared to typical restaurant brownies. The compact nutritional profile makes it easy to enjoy after any meal from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) without derailing your dietary goals.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this brownie apart is the Greyston brand commitment to social enterprise and quality ingredients. Made with real butter, dark cocoa, and wheat flour, each bite delivers authentic fudge brownie texture and taste. The dense, moist consistency and rich chocolate flavor profile make it a standout option on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) for chocolate lovers.
nutritionFacts: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie contains 150 calories with 2g protein, 17g carbohydrates, and 9g fat. This balanced macronutrient profile provides quick energy from carbs while the fat content delivers satisfying richness. For detailed nutritional breakdowns of all menu items, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your complete meal and track your intake accurately.
whatsInside: This brownie features a simple, quality ingredient list including wheat flour, dark cocoa, butter, sugar, and eggs. The dark cocoa provides deep chocolate flavor and antioxidants, while real butter creates the signature fudgy texture. No artificial additives or preservatives are used. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for specific dietary concerns regarding wheat, dairy, and eggs.
tasteLike: Expect a dense, fudgy brownie with intense dark chocolate flavor and a moist, melt-in-your-mouth texture. The rich cocoa delivers slightly bitter notes balanced by sweetness, while the butter adds luxurious creaminess. Unlike cakey brownies, this version offers concentrated chocolate intensity in every bite, making it the perfect sweet complement after savory selections from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains).
customize: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie comes as a perfectly portioned individual serving, ready to enjoy as-is. While customization options are limited for pre-packaged desserts, you can pair it with coffee or tea from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). Consider ordering multiple desserts to share, or combine with the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie for variety.
pairsWell: This chocolate brownie pairs exceptionally well with CAVA beverages like black coffee, mint tea, or cold brew. The rich chocolate complements Mediterranean flavors, making it ideal after bowls featuring [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) items like hummus or tzatziki. It also balances spicier mains beautifully, offering sweet relief after bold, savory flavors from your customized bowl or pita.
healthyChoice: At 150 calories, the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie offers portion-controlled indulgence for those monitoring intake. With 2g of protein and made from quality ingredients without artificial additives, it provides a more wholesome dessert option. While not low-calorie, it fits reasonably into balanced diets. Compare with other options on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) to find your best fit.
howToOrder: Order the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie at any CAVA location by requesting it when finalizing your meal at checkout. Available both in-store and through online ordering, simply add it to your cart alongside your bowl, pita, or salad. The brownie comes individually wrapped and ready to enjoy immediately or save for later. Find your nearest location at [CAVA Locations](/locations).
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie at 140 calories, this brownie offers richer chocolate intensity with just 10 additional calories. The Whisked cookies contain significantly more calories at 220-260, making the brownie a lighter choice. For chocolate purists, the fudge brownie delivers more concentrated cocoa flavor than the blondie, while cookies provide crunchier texture and unique flavor profiles.
whoShouldTry: Chocolate lovers seeking authentic fudge brownie experience will appreciate this dessert. Those looking for portion-controlled treats under 200 calories should definitely try it. Anyone following a Mediterranean-inspired meal who wants a classic American dessert finale will enjoy this option. It suits both dine-in guests and those ordering takeout who want a reliable, satisfying sweet treat.
worthTrying: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie absolutely delivers on quality, taste, and value at under $3. Its social enterprise background, premium ingredients, and perfect portion size make it worthwhile. The rich, authentic chocolate flavor satisfies dessert cravings without excessive calories. Whether you are a regular CAVA customer or first-time visitor, this brownie provides a delicious ending to your Mediterranean dining experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie?
faqs.a: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie contains 150 calories per serving, with 2g protein, 17g carbohydrates, and 9g fat. This makes it a relatively moderate dessert option compared to other sweet treats on the CAVA menu.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie at CAVA?
faqs.a: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie is priced between $2.75 and $2.95, depending on your location. This competitive pricing makes it an affordable dessert addition to any CAVA meal, whether you order a bowl, pita, or salad.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie?
faqs.a: The brownie is made with wheat flour, dark cocoa, butter, sugar, and eggs. These quality ingredients create the signature fudgy texture and rich chocolate flavor. The simple recipe contains no artificial preservatives or additives for a more wholesome dessert experience.

faqs.q: Is the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie is not gluten-free as it contains wheat flour as a primary ingredient. Those with gluten sensitivities should check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu for suitable dessert alternatives or consult the allergen information before ordering.

faqs.q: How does the Greyston Brownie compare to other CAVA desserts?
faqs.a: The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie offers richer chocolate flavor than the Chocolate Chip Blondie and contains fewer calories than Whisked cookies. At 150 calories and $2.75-$2.95, it provides excellent value for chocolate lovers seeking authentic fudge brownie taste and texture.
